campaign: Colibri2: consumer-safe shared inference and measured capability gains
doctrine:
Owned worktree: C:/Users/jeffm/overgo_colibri2 on codex/colibri2, based on master 0aa9853d0454caf6391538232da5344876c07135. docs/plan.json is this lane's sole live execution plan. The prior Colibri docs/plan.json at e18cf921 is the starting task inventory; its completed/pruned steps are historical evidence, not automatic completion credit here. Preserve master rows as foreign owned during gated bootstrap, then use the existing lane projection to omit them with no completion credit. Never import master's queue into Colibri2's scoped queue or change master from this worktree.

At each implementation boundary inspect the branch and active claims, pin current master and use first-parent-target merge authority while preserving this plan. Review incoming code before changing tasks; retire duplicate work only with verified acceptance. Execute one focused step through cmd/plan dispatch, test the declared outcome, then commit through cmd/gate. A plan-only adoption under this explicit user request includes its reviewed source and structural guard changes. Seed this worktree's independent store with a verified snapshot of master's ancestor receipts; never share a live store or import another lane's completion credit, supervisor session, stop control or artifact identity.

Priority: restore basic model correctness before MoE expansion. Master rolled back Colibri's declared NFC and pre-tokenizer activation after RxBrain VQA regressed. Restore the useful common components with full deployed-consumer coverage and independent references. The RxBrain artifact has an empty normalization Sequence and ordered number/CJK/Unicode Split expressions; support their exact semantics with acceptance on the actual VQA path. Stage declared encoding safely: the new compiler refuses unsupported declarations explicitly; the deployed legacy path remains until full consumer parity is proven. Silent fallback from the compiled path hides defects. Do not credit the former 92-case oracle or eight retained consumer vectors as proof of the missing RxBrain behavior. They remain regression inputs to reacquire against pinned source and master. Current master already integrated EOS metadata, template indexes, reasoning channels and evaluation metadata. The media owner is its reviewed delta registry, and GUI cleanup is integrated; extend those owners rather than create replacements.

Common components serve actual consumers. Recipe and artifact declarations select model facts. Reuse the Go/CUDA runtime, typed inference, cache, placement, scheduling, verification and workbench owners; remove displaced code when migrating callers. Compare on fixed external workloads and held-out tasks, with stable artifacts, tokenizer IDs, sampling, source, budgets and residency. Bitwise equality where promised and justified tolerances elsewhere. Operation counts guide investigation; only paired end-to-end latency, throughput, quality, memory and total useful-result cost justify promotion. Keep raw negative and no-gain results. Use caller-declared budgets and resource admission, not assumed host or GPU capacity.

The gate and its hermetic, device, browser and model lanes own acceptance. Exact named tests must run with non-skipped results; missing models, zero-match selectors and UNAVAILABLE are not passes. A new model accuracy claim needs an independent numerical oracle; structural tiny fixtures do not substitute for it. UI metrics must distinguish measured values from estimates and preserve accessibility and durable replay. Each step has a concrete owner, dependency and verifier. Resolve editable blockers in this lane without weakening checks. Record source licenses, limitation, rollback and affected output reacquisition. A stopped or unavailable prerequisite remains explicit, and independent ready work may continue. This is supervised improvement, not a claim of full autonomous RSI.

steps.rationale: W3.7. Decode/hash immutable vocabulary once per runner, share the binding through existing sampling grammar APIs, keep mutable parse state private. Verify distinct grammars/concurrent callers do not contaminate one another, signatures/output unchanged, second-compile decode count zero and allocations independent of vocabulary size. Retire displaced cloning paths. Split after inspecting state.go: the persisted FNV stream includes source/root before vocabulary, so ordinary prehash composition would change signatures. Reuse the binding slice and resolve hash-once while preserving exact legacy state signatures and bounded memory across distinct grammars; do not count decoding/allocation reuse as hash-once completion. TestGBNFVocabularyHashReuse is an implementation obligation, not existing evidence. Any performance promotion still requires paired total-generation evidence. The prior lane's binding and hash-study steps are historical evidence, not completion credit in Colibri2; inspect their current-master behavior before implementing the remaining hash-once proof.
